description: Defines the TraceControl plugin class with nested classes for managing trace sources, observers, and configuration, including JSON serialization and plugin lifecycle methods.

classes.name: TraceControl
classes.description: Main plugin class managing trace control, lifecycle, and JSON interfaces.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications, trace source observation, and background processing.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer::Source
classes.description: Represents a trace data source, manages cyclic buffer, and trace entry parsing.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer::ModuleIterator
classes.description: Iterates over modules and categories for trace filtering.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer::ModuleIterator::CategoryInfo
classes.description: Stores category name and enabled/disabled state.

classes.name: TraceControl::InformationWrapper
classes.description: Wraps trace source info for JSON serialization.

classes.name: TraceControl::NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents network configuration for remote trace output.

classes.name: TraceControl::Data
classes.description: JSON data structure for trace settings and status.

classes.name: TraceControl::Trace
classes.description: JSON representation of individual trace module/category state.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches trace source info to outputs.

methods.name: TranslateState
methods.description: Converts internal state enum to JSON enum.
